subject: science
note: Original Class 6–10 science path plus selected Class 11–12 ideas that UPSC/BPSC actually ask. Mechanism first, names second.

chapters.title: Food: Where Does It Come From?
chapters.summary: Sources of food, plant vs animal, ingredients vs sources. Food security later sits on this.

chapters.title: Components of Food
chapters.summary: Carbs, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, fibre, water. Deficiency diseases. Balanced diet.

chapters.title: Fibre to Fabric
chapters.summary: Plant and animal fibres, spinning, weaving. Link to industry geography later.

chapters.title: Sorting Materials into Groups
chapters.summary: Properties: lustre, hardness, soluble, density, transparent. Classification is scientific method.

chapters.title: Separation of Substances
chapters.summary: Handpicking, sieving, filtration, evaporation, condensation. Mixtures vs pure substances.

chapters.title: Changes Around Us
chapters.summary: Reversible vs irreversible, physical vs chemical. Heating, burning, rusting.

chapters.title: Getting to Know Plants
chapters.summary: Herbs shrubs trees, root stem leaf flower. Photosynthesis preview. Transpiration.

chapters.title: Body Movements

chapters.title: The Living Organisms — Characteristics
chapters.summary: Habitat, adaptation, life processes. Desert, mountain, aquatic adaptations.

chapters.title: Motion and Measurement of Distances
chapters.summary: Rest and motion, SI units, measurement. Precision matters in science and in GS data.

chapters.title: Light, Shadows and Reflections
chapters.summary: Rectilinear propagation, pinhole, mirrors. Later Class 10 optics builds here.

chapters.title: Electricity and Circuits
chapters.summary: Cell, bulb, switch, conductors vs insulators. Safety.

chapters.title: Fun with Magnets
chapters.summary: Poles, compass, Earth’s magnetism. Navigation history.

chapters.title: Water
chapters.summary: Cycle, drought, flood, conservation. Direct GS-III overlap.

chapters.title: Air Around Us
chapters.summary: Composition, oxygen for burning and breathing, atmosphere. Link later to pollution.

chapters.title: Garbage In, Garbage Out
chapters.summary: Vermicompost, plastics, 3Rs. Waste is a governance problem.

chapters.title: Nutrition in Plants & Animals
chapters.summary: Photosynthesis equation idea, heterotrophs, human digestive system. Autotroph vs heterotroph.

chapters.summary: Animal fibres in more depth. Sericulture as livelihood.

chapters.title: Heat
chapters.summary: Temperature, conduction convection radiation, land–sea breeze. Climate physics starts here.

chapters.title: Acids, Bases and Salts
chapters.summary: Indicators, natural acids, neutralisation. Everyday chemicals (baking soda, calamine).

chapters.summary: Rusting, crystallisation, chemical equations idea. Conservation of mass flavour.

chapters.title: Weather, Climate and Adaptations

chapters.title: Soil

chapters.summary: Hormones, puberty, reproductive health, gender myths. Health education as public policy.

chapters.title: Friction

chapters.summary: Vibration, frequency, amplitude, human ear, noise pollution. Policy on noise.

chapters.summary: Laws, regular/diffused, multiple mirrors, human eye, Braille. Care of eyes.

chapters.summary: Moon phases, planets, constellations, artificial satellites. Bridge to ISRO CA.

chapters.summary: Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr, electrons protons neutrons, valency, isotopes. Nuclear energy later.

chapters.title: Chemical Reactions and Equations
chapters.summary: Types of reactions, redox, corrosion, rancidity. Balancing.

chapters.title: Heredity and Evolution
